author: chin
title: Fanfic half-body illustration commission
content: Hi, lovely artists! I am looking for an artist to commission for an art. I am currently working on a fanfic, and it would be sooo nice to have an art that would represent it. No AI allowed. Half body (includes 2 characters in one art). May or may not have experience drawing KPop idols (can capture features well). Loves working with colors. Not required to be an ATINY. No anime/cartoon artstyle. Deadline: Not rushed; would be great to have it ready before November. Please send your comms sheet or you can also dm me your rates. Thank you so much! Contact: DM @mcdanigan
